claims.claim: PEGI has started raising the age rating of digital games with loot boxes to 16, with the rollout expected to continue through October.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says PEGI has started raising the age ratings of digital games featuring loot boxes to 16, with the rollout expected throughout October.

claims.claim: The UK's Games Rating Authority, which administers PEGI in the UK, said existing digital-only games rated PEGI 3, 7 or 12 that contain paid random items will be re-rated PEGI 16.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer quotes the Games Rating Authority's LinkedIn post.
claims.quote: Existing digital-only games that are currently rated PEGI 3, 7 or 12 and feature Paid random items, such as loot boxes, will have their age rating updated to PEGI 16 – Paid random items.

claims.claim: Newly submitted games have been assessed against the expanded criteria since June.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer quotes the post: since June, newly submitted games have been assessed against an expanded set of criteria including interactive risks.
claims.quote: Since June, newly submitted games have been assessed against an expanded set of criteria within the PEGI rating framework, including new criteria relating to interactive risks.

claims.claim: The EA Sports FC series, previously rated PEGI 3, and Zenless Zone Zero, previously PEGI 12, are among the games moved to 16.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says the EA Sports FC series, previously rated PEGI 3, is included, and Zenless Zone Zero went from 12 to 16.

claims.claim: PEGI announced in March that it would tackle loot boxes, addictive mechanics and unmonitored online communication.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer says the shift follows PEGI's March announcement that it would tackle loot boxes and similar microtransactions, addictive game mechanics and unmonitored online communication.

claims.claim: EA Sports FC 25 is rated PEGI 3, while EA Sports FC 27 is rated PEGI 16, with its purchase options listed in the rating.
claims.evidence: PC Gamer says FC 25 is rated PEGI 3 with no rating issues, while FC 27 is PEGI 16 with a breakdown of purchase options including FC points, a season pass and player packs.

claims.claim: North America's ESRB has said it will not follow PEGI; EA Sports FC 27 is rated E (Everyone) by the ESRB with a note about in-game purchases.
claims.evidence: PC Gamer says the ESRB indicated it will not follow, with a rep saying in March that adding non-content features could confuse parents, and FC 27 is rated E with a note on user interactions and in-game purchases.

claims.claim: PEGI's new interactive risk categories cover in-game purchases, paid random items, communication features and features that push players to keep playing.
claims.evidence: PC Gamer quotes PEGI's categories.
claims.quote: purchases of in-game content, paid random items, communication features, and features that incentivise players to continue playing.

claims.claim: Pokémon TCG Pocket and Fire Emblem Heroes have also been re-rated 16, according to PocketGamer.biz.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun says PocketGamer.biz reports Pokémon TCG Pocket is newly rated 16, as is Fire Emblem Heroes.

claims.claim: It is unclear whether PEGI is also applying its other March proposals, such as PEGI 12 for battle passes and PEGI 18 for NFT and blockchain mechanics.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun says it is unclear if PEGI is also applying other proposed changes: PEGI 12 for time-limited content like battle passes, PEGI 18 for NFTs or blockchain mechanisms, PEGI 12 for play-by-appointment; the post and PEGI's update cover only paid random items.

claims.claim: The Games Rating Authority acknowledged that many rating changes will happen over a short period.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun quotes the post.
claims.quote: We recognise that a high volume of rating changes will take place over a relatively short period.

claims.claim: Belgium has treated paid loot boxes as gambling since 2018, and New York's attorney general sued Valve in 2026 to have loot boxes classified as gambling.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun says the Belgian government has treated paid loot boxes as gambling since 2018 and refers to the New York attorney general's 2026 suit against Valve, which Valve moved to dismiss.

claims.claim: The change applies to digital-only games.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer emphasises that the ruling impacts digital-only games.
